dialogue.en: Hey, the machine on line 3 is broken.
dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 嘿，3 号线的机器坏了。

dialogue.en: What happened? When did it stop?
dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 怎么回事？什么时候停的？

dialogue.en: It just stopped working. I think something's stuck inside.
dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.zh: 刚停的，里面好像卡住了。

dialogue.en: Okay, stop the line. I'll call maintenance.
dialogue.speaker: Supervisor
dialogue.zh: 好的，先停线，我叫维修的人来。

phrases.en: There's something wrong with the machine.
Can someone come take a look?
